tickets.text: Add to would_change: a danger signal ends it on sight, a one-day fade of two atr_14d off the day's high (my atr_14d translation, not Livermore's literal six points, C7); and EXC/PEG failing to make new highs with WTRG breaks the group confirmation (C14).

Add to would_change: after a close at 99% of the range, a one-day fade of two atr_14d off the day's high is the danger signal and ends the case on sight (my atr_14d translation, not Livermore's literal six points, C7).

VRTX is still inside its reaction: D 2.7% under its high, no new high yet. A buy over a green bar's high buys the pullback itself, which C5 forbids. I sign only when the trigger is a close above pivot_high 529.89, the new high that proves the reaction is over (C5, C19).
